title: Meta launches Muse Code as a lower-cost terminal coding agent
friendlyTitle: Meta releases a cheaper AI coding helper
summary: Meta released Muse Code in beta alongside its coding-focused Muse Spark 1.2 model. The terminal agent can plan changes, write code and validate results, with pay-as-you-go access and a cheaper contributor tier that opts users into model improvement.
friendlySummary: Muse Code is a new terminal tool that can plan, write and check software changes. Meta is offering normal paid access and a cheaper option for people who agree to help improve the model.
whyItMatters: Another major supplier is competing on the cost of complete coding workflows rather than chat alone. Developers should compare total task quality, data-retention terms and review effort—not just token prices—before moving real repositories into the tool.
friendlyWhyItMatters: More competition may lower the cost of AI coding. Check the privacy rules and review its work carefully before using it on important code.
